notes.title: The Sojourn: A Brand New Update for a Smoother Journey
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone, 
[/h3][p]Long time no see. We just wanted to check in to let everybody know that we [b]just released a brand-new update for The Sojourn[/b].

We recently noticed that there were compatibility issues that [b]stopped The Sojourn from running on Windows 11 in some instances.[/b] We’ve been working on a fix that’ll hopefully address those issues. We’re always dedicated to making our games as widely accessible as possible and we hope this fix will help future-proof and [b]preserve The Sojourn for next-gen players[/b].

On that note, we’re also currently [b]tinkering with some other ways of bringing the game to new players; but more on that in the future[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33286100/f3be4c99123e212d6a98e6a8bcc70aa4d6b8bdd1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Connect with us to stay up to date![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747657/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png"][/img]  [b]The Sojourn[/b] [/p][list][*][p]  [url="https://twitter.com/The_Sojourn"]Twitter[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]  [url="https://www.facebook.com/thesojourngame/"]Facebook[/url] [/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Iceberg Interactive[/b] [/p][list][*][p]  [url="http://www.twitter.com/iceberg_int"]Twitter[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]  [url="https://www.facebook.com/iceberginteractive"]Facebook[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]  [url="https://www.youtube.com/iceberginteractive"]YouTube[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]  [url="https://www.twitch.tv/iceberg_int"]Twitch[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]  [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/iceberg"]Steam Publisher Page[/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Sojourn is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're excited to announce that The Sojourn is now available on Steam! Dive into a beautiful world where you have to carefully balance light and darkness to solve puzzles and traverse parallel worlds. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33286100/3da902c32f36692aeea49ef6a625afbd4f216b7f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33286100/65f79db4b9608e7b4afc3275f222fe16a30b2374.jpg[/img]

[h2]Key features[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Dozens-upon-dozens of challenging puzzles
[*]     Delve into four beautifully crafted chapters, each with their own distinct style and atmosphere
[*]     Banish the darkness in order to reveal the obstacles The Sojourn has prepared for you
[*]     Unravel a captivating tale of light, darkness, and the nature of reality
[*]     An incredible, soothing soundtrack 
[/list]

If that sounds like something you enjoy, we have some more good news for you. You can pick up The Sojourn at a [b]33% discount[/b] during the Steam launch week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/794960/The_Sojourn/

[h2]Deluxe & Gold editions[/h2]

Want to dive deeper into the mystical world of The Sojourn? You can with the Digital Deluxe Edition and Gold Pack! Both packs include an early prototype of The Sojourn called [i]Equilibrium[/i], an artbook for said prototype, and an artbook for The Sojourn. The Gold Pack also includes the soundtrack to The Sojourn, composed by the incredible [url=https://twitter.com/nima_nemo]Nemo Ghasemi[/url]!

notes.title: The Sojourn's statue-swapping puzzles launch September
notes.notes:
You know that feeling where you re not quite sure what s going on, but you re happy to be here anyway? That s the impression I get from the trailer for The Sojourn, a pretty puzzly thing that s scheduled to come out in a couple of months. I don t exactly know what kind of tasks it’ll be asking me to do, or why. But I probably wouldn t mind just hanging out in that lovely Santorini-like spot to do em. Take a look at the trailer, you ll see what I mean.

notes.title: Strange indie games to watch from Gamescom 2018
notes.notes:
There were a lot of games at Gamescom. A lot of them were good and interesting, but I didn t get enough time with them to write you thousands of words, or they re not quite done enough yet. They re a souffl that needs more time to rise. But I still wanted to tell you about them, these strange little souffl s in many different flavours. An alternate universe horror game starring Nikola Tesla. A game where you manage orphans. The most ambitious MMO that may never get made. A noir story set against the backdrop of all of creation. Please enjoy this tasting menu.

notes.title: Thought Provoking First-Person Puzzle Game ‘The Sojourn’ Coming To PC, PS4 & Xbox One In 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33286100/a7213c480021a503eb6cc865e90f7f00bba26f1e.jpg[/img]

Iceberg Interactive is pleased to announce Shifting Tides’ first game, [url=https://www.thesojourngame.com]The Sojourn[/url]. [b]The Sojourn[/b] is a first-person puzzle game in which you traverse parallel worlds of light and darkness in search of answers to the nature of reality. The game is slated for release on PC, PS4 and Xbox One in 2019.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p_8LQK_5u3Y
[h1]The Sojourn Story[/h1]
You are born into a beautiful, pure land, but everything is not as it seems. Darkness seeps through every crevice and forms the foundation of the world you live in. Open your eyes to the shadows of the world to uncover the hidden truth.

Venture into the enchanting world of The Sojourn and face life’s obstacles by solving dozens of unique puzzles that will challenge your perception of your own reality. Take in gorgeous environments as you delve into the game’s four chapters, each with a distinct atmosphere and style.

[h1]The Sojourn Key features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Dozens-upon-dozens of challenging puzzles
[*] Delve into four beautifully crafted chapters, each with their own distinct style and atmosphere
[*] Banish the darkness in order to reveal the obstacles The Sojourn has prepared for you
[*] Unravel a captivating tale of light, darkness, and the nature of reality.
[/list]
Aspiring sojourners can sign up to the newsletter via the [url=https://www.thesojourngame.com/]official website[/url], to be notified when the game becomes available. PC gamers will know when the game releases by wishlisting the game on Steam.
